description: Deed of variation which proposes to replace the provision of 32 on-site affordable homes with a payment in lieu to the council, by amending the section 106 agreement relating to planning permission ref. 20/AP/3285 dated 20 April 2022 (Demolition of all buildings on the site and construction of a development of 91 residential units within four buildings (a 7-storey Block A building, a 6-storey Block B/C building and two buildings in Block D of 2- and 4-storeys), together with alterations to the retained basement, provision of car and cycle parking and landscaping).  The deed would include the associated amendments to the s106 agreement to delete definitions, clauses and schedules 2, 3, 11 and 12 relating to affordable housing and viability.
